name: invoice-approval-desk
description: Mini invoice approval desk: Next.js web (3000) + NestJS API (3001) + SQLite.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:prod -w api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test:e2e -w api
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && npm exec -w web -- next typegen && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
